# InterconnectionStrengthEncoding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of encoding information in the variable resistance or conductance of dendritic junctions, representing event patterns as weighted connections. This aligns with TCC's goal of embedding computation in the topology and physical properties of the interconnect itself.
